from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """The extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to the cause of action."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action or nature of administrative act as stated in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for the extracted data from a single judgment document."""
    judgments: list[JudgmentRecord]
